guide.gettingStartedContent:
Welcome to the platform! This guide will help you get oriented and make the most of every feature.

## Signing In

Sign in with your email address and password. If you are a new user, an administrator will provide you with a temporary password — you will be asked to set your own password the first time you sign in. If you forget your password, an administrator can reset it for you.

The application is organized around your sidebar navigation. Depending on your role and permissions, you will see different modules available to you.

## Navigation

Use the sidebar on the left to navigate between modules. The sidebar is organized into groups: Workspace for day-to-day tools, Help & Support for guidance and coaching, Operations for resource and time management, and Administration for system configuration.

## Your Dashboard

The Dashboard is your home page. It provides a high-level executive overview of portfolio health, at-risk projects, overdue milestones, and business outcomes. Start here each day to see what needs your attention.

## Getting Help

If you have questions about governance stages, deliverables, or RACI assignments, use the Governance Coach — an AI-powered assistant available in the Help & Support section.
guide.dashboardContent:
The Dashboard is your Mission Control center — an executive view that consolidates the state of your entire portfolio at a glance.

## What You'll See

The dashboard displays portfolio-level KPIs including active projects, health distribution, and margin exposure. Dedicated panels highlight at-risk projects, overdue milestones, critical RAID items, governance gate exceptions, and business outcomes at risk. A health heatmap shows how every project scores across the four health dimensions.

## How to Use It

The dashboard updates automatically as data changes across the platform. Use it as your starting point each day: scan the heatmap for red or amber projects, review overdue milestones and critical RAID items, and check outcomes flagged as at risk.

Most rows and cards are clickable — click any project, milestone, or outcome to navigate directly to its detail page for deeper analysis.

The pipeline card also shows the Weighted Pipeline — the sum of each open opportunity's Buffered Price multiplied by its Confidence %.
guide.dashboardConcepts:
- Health Heatmap: Grid showing every project's score across the four health dimensions
- Margin Exposure: Projects whose gross margin has fallen below target
- Gate Exceptions: Projects that progressed without fully meeting gate criteria
- Critical RAID: High-severity risks, issues, or dependencies needing attention
- At-Risk Outcomes: Business outcomes whose status is At Risk
guide.opportunitiesContent:
The Opportunities module manages your pre-sales pipeline from initial qualification through to winning or losing a deal.

## Creating an Opportunity

Click "New Opportunity" to create a new entry. Provide a name, select the associated company, choose a region, and optionally add a description and Salesforce Cloud tags.

## Pipeline Stages

Each opportunity progresses through five stages: Qualifying, Estimating, Proposed, Won, and Lost. Update the stage as the opportunity advances through your sales process.

## Estimation

Within each opportunity, you can build detailed resource-based estimates with phases, workstreams, and rate cards. The financial model calculates Base Cost, Risk-Adjusted Price, and Buffered Price automatically.

## Converting to a Project

Once an opportunity is Won and has passed its Stage 0 governance gate, you can convert it to a delivery project with a single click. This copies all phases, workstreams, milestones, resources, and RAID items to the new project.

## Initial Estimate

While an opportunity is Qualifying or Estimating, you can record an Initial Estimate — a rough deal value used before a detailed estimate exists. When no synced estimate price is available, the Buffered Price falls back to the Initial Estimate adjusted by the risk and buffer percentages. Once the opportunity reaches Proposed, Won, or Lost, the Initial Estimate is locked.

## Confidence % & Weighted Value

Each open opportunity can carry a Confidence % (0–100) representing the likelihood of winning. The Weighted Value equals the Buffered Price multiplied by the Confidence %, and appears on the Opportunities list, the opportunity detail page, and the Dashboard's Weighted Pipeline. Won opportunities are always 100% confidence and Lost are always 0%; if no confidence is set, 100% is assumed.

## Won Margin Approval

Administrators can define a minimum gross margin threshold for winning deals. If you mark an opportunity as Won below that threshold, the change is held as a pending approval request. Only Org Admins and Super Admins can approve or reject it; approvers moving a deal to Won themselves are approved automatically.

## Operating Model

Each opportunity selects one active Operating Model that defines its governance stages. Selecting a model is reversible, but once you Confirm it in the Governance tab, the model is locked and carries over when the opportunity is converted to a project.
guide.opportunitiesConcepts:
- Qualifying: Initial assessment of the opportunity
- Estimating: Building resource-based cost estimates
- Proposed: Formal proposal submitted to the client
- Won/Lost: Final outcome of the opportunity
- Buffered Price: Final price including risk and buffer adjustments
- Base Cost: Total cost calculated from hours multiplied by cost rates
- Gross Margin: (Buffered Price - Base Cost) / Buffered Price
- Initial Estimate: Early deal value entered before a detailed estimate; locked from Proposed onward
- Confidence %: Likelihood (0–100%) of winning an open opportunity; Won = 100%, Lost = 0%
- Weighted Value: Buffered Price × Confidence %, shown for open opportunities only
- Won Margin Approval: Approval required to mark a deal Won below the minimum margin threshold
guide.projectsContent:
The Projects module is where you plan, track, and manage delivery work.

## Creating a Project

Create projects manually by clicking "New Project" or by converting a won opportunity. Each project has a title, description, theme, and date format. You can also import milestones from Excel or CSV files.

## Milestones & Tasks

Organize work into milestones (major deliverables or checkpoints) and tasks beneath them. Each item has dates, status, and optional financial obligations. View your timeline in a visual Gantt-style layout.

## Health Indicators

Track project health across four dimensions: Overall, Scope, Budget, and Team. Each uses a Green/Amber/Red status to provide a quick visual assessment.

## Progress Tracking

Update weekly percentage-complete values per workstream. Phase progress auto-calculates from child workstreams using duration-weighted averages.

## EVM Dashboard

Access full Earned Value Management metrics including BAC, PV, AC, EV, SV, CV, SPI, CPI, EAC, and ETC. View S-Curve charts and CPI/SPI performance trends over time.
guide.projectsConcepts:
- Milestone: A significant checkpoint or deliverable in the project timeline
- Health Status: Green (on track), Amber (at risk), Red (off track)
- EVM: Earned Value Management — industry-standard method for measuring project performance
- CPI: Cost Performance Index — measures cost efficiency (EV/AC)
- SPI: Schedule Performance Index — measures schedule efficiency (EV/PV)
- Phase: A high-level grouping of related workstreams
- Workstream: A specific stream of work within a phase
guide.clientsContent:
The Companies module maintains your client directory.

## Managing Companies

Add companies with a name, legal name, and industry classification. Each company also supports Segment, Country, and Phone fields. All edits are made inline — click on a field in the table to edit it directly, then save your changes.

## Finding Companies

Use the search bar to quickly find companies by name, legal name, or industry. Click any column header to sort, and use the filter row to narrow the list by industry, segment, country, or status.

## Company Detail

Click on a company row to open its detail page. Here you can view and manage all contacts associated with the company, see linked projects and opportunities, and update company information including the legal name.

## Linking to Projects

When creating projects or opportunities, you can link them to a company. This provides full traceability across your portfolio, letting you see all work associated with a particular client.
guide.contactsContent:
The Contacts module manages the people at your client companies.

## Managing Contacts

Add contacts with names, roles, email addresses, and phone numbers. Each contact is associated with a company, and can be classified with a stakeholder type to clarify their role in your engagements.

## Stakeholder Mapping

Use stakeholder types (such as sponsor, decision maker, or influencer) to map who matters in each account. This helps project and sales teams engage the right people at the right time.

## Working with Contacts

Contacts appear on their company's detail page. Use them when planning communications, stakeholder engagement, and governance reviews.
guide.teamMembersContent:
The Team Members module manages the people who work on your projects.

## Adding Team Members

Click "Add Member" to create a new team member. Provide their name, role, department, and cost rates (monthly and/or hourly). You can also enable app access to allow them to log in.

## App Access

Team members with app access enabled can log in and access the platform. Those without app access are tracked for estimation and allocation purposes only.

## Searching & Filtering

Use the search bar to find members by name. The list supports inline editing — click any field to update it directly, then save all changes at once.

## Linking to Users

In the Admin Security section, you can link team members to user accounts. This enables record-level access filtering so team members only see projects they are assigned to.
guide.allocationsContent:
The Allocations module provides a matrix view for resource planning across your portfolio.

## How It Works

The allocation matrix shows team members on rows and projects on columns, with weekly hour values in each cell. This gives you a clear picture of who is working on what and how much capacity they have.

## Capacity Indicators

Each team member's total weekly hours are color-coded:
- Optimal: Within expected capacity
- Under Capacity: Available for more work
- Over Capacity: At risk of being overloaded

## Managing Allocations

Allocations are typically created from the project detail page when assigning team members. The Allocations module provides a read-only portfolio view across all projects.
guide.timesheetsContent:
The Timesheets module lets team members record actual daily effort hours.

## Logging Time

Select a team member and navigate to the desired week. Add rows for each project and workstream combination, then enter daily hours for Monday through Sunday.

## Weekly View

The timesheet displays one week at a time. Use the week navigation to move between weeks. Total hours are calculated automatically for each day and for the overall week.

## Adding Rows

Click "Add Row" to add a new project/workstream combination. Select the project first, then choose from available workstreams. The system only shows workstreams for projects the team member is allocated to.
guide.reportsContent:
The Reports module provides operational and executive reporting across your portfolio.

## Available Reports

Reports are organized into categories:
- Project & Delivery: Portfolio Health, Project Status, Milestone Tracker, RAID Summary
- Strategic: Business Outcomes
- Financial: Cost Tracking, Margin Analysis (coming soon)
- Resources: Team Utilization, Timesheet Summary (coming soon)
- Pipeline: Opportunity Pipeline, Revenue Forecast (coming soon)
- Executive: EVM Executive Summary (coming soon)

## Using Reports

Click on a report card to open it. Most reports support filtering by project, company, region, and health status. Use the export buttons to download reports as CSV or PDF for offline distribution.

## Portfolio Health Report

The Portfolio Health report provides an overview of all projects with health indicators, stages, and status. Filter by health color, company, or region to focus on specific areas. For interactive analysis with trends and drill-down, use the dedicated Portfolio Health view in the sidebar.

## Business Outcomes Report

The Business Outcomes report lists all registered outcomes with their status, baseline, target, and current values, plus their linked companies and projects — ideal for value realisation reviews.

## Opportunity Pipeline Report

The Opportunity Pipeline report (Pipeline category) gives a filterable view of your pre-sales pipeline:
- Filter by company, region, industry, Salesforce Cloud, status, segment, country, and strategic accounts. Filters combine, and Clear all resets them.
- Summary cards show total opportunities, total open pipeline (buffered price), weighted pipeline, and won value.
- The dynamic chart updates with your filters — switch the measure (Count, Buffered Price, Weighted Value) and grouping (Status, Region, Industry, Salesforce Cloud).
- The sortable table lists each opportunity with confidence % and computed values, linking to the opportunity detail page.
- Export the filtered data to CSV or PDF.
guide.reportsConcepts:
- Portfolio Health: Aggregated view of project health across the organization
- Project Status: Detailed single-project snapshot with financials, tasks, and EVM
- Milestone Tracker: Upcoming, overdue, and completed milestones with financial obligations
- RAID Summary: Consolidated Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies across all projects
guide.raidContent:
The RAID Log tracks Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies for each project.

## RAID Types

Each entry is categorized as one of four types:
- Risk: Something that might happen and would negatively impact the project
- Assumption: Something assumed to be true for planning purposes
- Issue: A current problem that needs to be addressed
- Dependency: Something the project depends on from an external source

## Managing RAID Items

RAID items are managed from the project detail page. Create entries with a title, description, type, status, priority, and optional impact/probability scores (for risks).

## Status Tracking

Each RAID item has a status (Open, Closed, Mitigated, Accepted) and priority level. Use the owner field to assign responsibility and the due date to track resolution timelines.
guide.raidConcepts:
- Risk: Potential future event with negative impact (scored by probability and impact)
- Assumption: Condition assumed true for planning
- Issue: Current problem requiring resolution
- Dependency: External requirement the project relies on
- Probability: Likelihood of a risk occurring
- Impact: Severity of consequence if a risk materializes
guide.governanceContent:
The Governance module provides a stage-gated framework for managing the project lifecycle, and the AI-powered Governance Coach helps you navigate it.

## Stage-Gated Framework

Projects progress through configurable governance stages, each with defined deliverables, RACI matrices, and gate criteria. Gates act as quality checkpoints — a project must satisfy gate criteria before advancing to the next stage.

## Governance Coach

The Governance Coach is an AI-powered assistant that can answer questions about governance stages, deliverables, RACI roles, and gate requirements. Access it from the Help & Support section in the sidebar.

## Deliverables & RACI

Each stage has associated deliverables — documents or artifacts that must be produced. RACI matrices define who is Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed for each deliverable.

## Gate Evaluation

When ready, request an AI-powered gate evaluation that checks checkpoint completion, artifact presence, RAID status, and EVM indicators. The evaluation provides a structured pass/fail recommendation.

## Exception Workflow

If a gate cannot be passed, project managers can request an exception with justification. Approvers review and approve or reject exception requests.

## Operating Models

Administrators can define multiple named operating models in Settings > Governance Framework, each with its own stages and deliverables. Opportunities and projects follow the stages of their selected model.
guide.governanceConcepts:
- Stage: A phase in the governance lifecycle with specific deliverables and a gate
- Gate: A quality checkpoint that must be passed before advancing
- RACI: Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed — defines roles per deliverable
- Deliverable: A document or artifact required at a governance stage
- Exception: A formal request to bypass a gate requirement with justification
guide.adminContent:
The Administration section provides tools for configuring the platform to match your organization's needs.

## Settings

Configure general settings including the governance framework label, language, and feature toggles (such as enabling/disabling the Opportunities module). Manage branding with custom app name, logo, favicon, and color scheme.

## Rate Cards

Define regional rate cards with roles, cost rates, and bill rates. Rate cards are used in estimation to calculate project costs and pricing.

## Field Options

Customize dropdown options used across the application: project types, engagement models, statuses, roles, regions, and more.

## Security

Manage users and role assignments, define custom roles with specific module and permission access, view the Role Permission Matrix, and review the Audit Log for sensitive actions.

## API Tokens

Generate Bearer tokens for external API access. Tokens inherit the creating user's permissions and support configurable expiration periods.
guide.whatsNewContent:
A summary of the improvements delivered over the last 90 days (April – July 2026).

## Mission Control Dashboard

The Dashboard is now an executive Mission Control center. It highlights portfolio health, margin exposure, at-risk projects, overdue milestones, critical RAID items, and gate exceptions, plus a health heatmap across the portfolio. At-risk business outcome rows are clickable for quick navigation.

## Portfolio Health Cockpit

A dedicated Portfolio Health view is now available. It includes an executive project table with powerful filters and a drill-down drawer, four executive summary panels, FlightPath stage distribution, a health dimension heatmap, and 90-day trend charts backed by historical health tracking.

## Business Outcomes

A new Business Outcomes module tracks value realisation. Register outcomes with baseline, target, and current values; link them to companies, opportunities, projects, governance stages, and team members. Business Outcomes tabs are available on Project and Opportunity detail pages, and a Business Outcomes report was added to the Reports module.

## Companies & Contacts

- Companies now support Segment, Country, Phone, and Legal Name fields, all editable directly in the table with sorting and column filters.
- Contacts now support stakeholder types for clearer stakeholder mapping.

## Sign-In & Security

- The platform now uses email and password sign-in. New users receive a temporary password and must set their own password on first login.
- Administrators can reset user passwords from Security.
- Ongoing security hardening of tenant isolation and access controls.

## Opportunity Pricing & Pipeline

- Initial Estimate field for early-stage deals, locked once the opportunity is Proposed, Won, or Lost.
- Confidence % on open opportunities with a Weighted Value (Buffered Price × Confidence %) shown on the list, detail page, and Dashboard's Weighted Pipeline.
- Won Margin Approval: deals below the minimum margin threshold require Org Admin or Super Admin approval before being marked Won.

## Multiple Operating Models

Tenants can now define several named operating models, each with its own governance stages. Opportunities select and confirm one model; after confirmation the model is locked and carries into the converted project.
guide.businessOutcomesContent:
The Business Outcomes module is a strategic register for tracking the value your projects are expected to deliver — and whether that value is actually realised.

## Registering Outcomes

Create an outcome with a name, description, and measurable values: a baseline (where you start), a target (where you want to be), and a current value (where you are today). Track each outcome's status as it moves from Draft to Active and, ultimately, Achieved.

## Linking Outcomes

Outcomes can be linked to companies, opportunities, projects, governance stages, and team members. This creates full traceability from strategic goals down to delivery work. You can also manage outcomes directly from the Business Outcomes tab on any Project or Opportunity detail page.

## Monitoring Value

Outcomes flagged as At Risk surface on the Mission Control dashboard so leadership can act early. A Business Outcomes report in the Reports module provides a portfolio-wide view with export options.
guide.businessOutcomesConcepts:
- Baseline Value: The starting measurement before the initiative begins
- Target Value: The measurable goal the outcome aims to reach
- Current Value: The latest measured value, updated as progress is made
- Status: Draft, Active, Achieved, At Risk, or Cancelled
- Linking: Connecting an outcome to companies, opportunities, projects, stages, or team members for traceability
guide.portfolioHealthContent:
Portfolio Health is an executive cockpit that consolidates the health of every project in your portfolio into a single view.

## Executive Panels

Four summary panels at the top give an immediate read on the portfolio: overall health distribution, margin exposure, projects requiring attention, and governance gate status.

## Project Table & Drill-Down

The main table lists every project with its health indicators, FlightPath stage, financials, and status. Filters are applied on the server, so every panel and chart reflects exactly the filtered set of projects. Click a row to open the drill-down drawer with details, health history, and quick links.

## Heatmap & Stage Distribution

The dimension heatmap shows how each project scores across the four health dimensions, making it easy to spot systemic issues. The FlightPath distribution shows how many projects sit in each governance stage.

## Trends

Health changes are recorded over time, powering 90-day trend charts. Projects with no recent changes still display a true continuous trend line.
guide.portfolioHealthConcepts:
- Health Dimensions: Four configurable indicators (e.g. Scope, Schedule, Cost, Quality) scored Green, Amber, or Red
- FlightPath Stage: The governance stage a project currently occupies
- Drill-Down Drawer: A side panel with project details and health history, opened by clicking a table row
- 90-Day Trend: Historical view of health changes over the last 90 days
- Margin Exposure: Financial risk visible when project margins fall below expectations

about.tagline: Comprehensive Visual Project Planning, EVM & AI-Powered Governance Platform
about.overview: A unified, multi-tenant platform for project managers to plan, execute, and monitor projects with full visibility into scope, schedule, cost, and team performance. From pre-sales opportunity estimation through stage-gated delivery to value realization, the platform combines resource-based pricing, traditional project management, AI-powered governance coaching, earned value analysis, operational reporting, and role-based security to keep projects on track and stakeholders informed. Available in English, Spanish, and Portuguese with tenant-level locale configuration.
about.technicalSummaryText: Built on a modern web stack with React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui on the frontend, Express.js on Node.js with PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM on the backend. Full multi-tenant architecture with tenant isolation across all data tables, automated provisioning pipeline, and a two-layer RBAC security system with server-side enforcement and audit logging. AI-powered features leverage OpenAI integration for intelligent gate evaluation and conversational governance coaching. Internationalised for English, Spanish, and Portuguese with tenant-level locale selection using i18next. Operational reporting with server-side aggregation and CSV/PDF export. Real-time data updates via TanStack React Query, secure session-based authentication via Replit Auth (OpenID Connect) with optional Bearer token authentication for external API integrations, and a responsive design ensure the platform works reliably across devices and team sizes. All configuration, branding, governance frameworks, and field options are database-driven for easy customisation without code changes.
about.mod1Desc: Mission Control layout with portfolio-level metric cards, pipeline funnel bars, and a consolidated view of all active projects, health status, budgets, and key performance indicators.
about.mod2Desc: Centralised directory of companies, contacts, industries, and relationships. Link projects to companies for full traceability across the portfolio.
about.mod3Desc: Create and manage projects with visual timelines, milestones, hierarchical phases and workstreams, and configurable health indicators across four dimensions (Overall, Scope, Budget, Team).
about.mod4Desc: Full pre-sales pipeline with opportunity lifecycle management (Qualifying, Estimating, Proposed, Won, Lost). Price-driven financial model with risk and buffer adjustments. Milestones tab for tracking key dates and financial obligations. Stage 0 governance gate and one-click conversion to delivery projects with duplicate-conversion guard.
about.mod5Desc: Build detailed estimates with hierarchical phases and workstreams. Assign multiple resources per workstream using rate cards from any region, with duration-based hour calculations, confidence levels, and automatic financial roll-ups for pricing and cost. Select rate cards from multiple regions within a single estimate for hybrid delivery models.
about.mod6Desc: Track team members, define rate cards by role and region, assign resources to projects, and plan weekly allocations across the portfolio. Supports role-only entries for pre-sales planning with automatic team sync from estimates.
about.mod7Desc: Matrix view for team members' weekly hours across projects. Visual capacity planning to balance workloads and identify over/under-allocation across the portfolio.
about.mod8Desc: Record actual daily effort per team member, per project and workstream. Supports Mon-Sun daily entry with automatic weekly totalling and project-level aggregation.
about.mod9Desc: Weekly percentage-complete updates per workstream. Phases auto-calculate from child workstreams using duration-weighted averages.
about.mod10Desc: Full Earned Value Management suite: BAC, PV, AC, EV, SV, CV, SPI, CPI, EAC, and ETC. S-Curve charts (PV/AC/EV over time with BAC reference), CPI/SPI Performance Trend charts, snapshot versioning, and per-workstream breakdowns.
about.mod11Desc: Full Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies tracking per project with type-specific fields, probability/impact scoring for risks, and linkage to governance stages.
about.mod12Desc: Fully configurable stage-gated project lifecycle. Add, edit, reorder, and delete governance stages and deliverables per tenant. Define RACI accountability matrices with custom roles per deliverable. Gate enforcement with AI-powered readiness evaluation and document repository integration for artifact verification. Exception request workflow: PMs request exceptions with justification, approvers review and approve or reject. Opportunities must have 'won' status and a passed Stage 0 gate before converting to delivery projects.
about.mod13Desc: AI-powered natural language assistant (OpenAI) that guides project managers through the governance framework, explains stage requirements, RACI roles, and recommends next actions. Dynamically adapts to tenant-specific governance labels.
about.mod14Desc: Two-layer access model: Security Roles define module access and action permissions; Record-Level Filtering restricts visibility to assigned projects. 9 seeded system roles, custom Role Builder UI, Role Matrix viewer, and server-side enforcement on all endpoints.
about.mod15Desc: Full tenant isolation with automated provisioning pipeline. Global Admin console for tenant CRUD, usage stats, and tenant switching. Super Admin controls for platform-wide governance.
about.mod16Desc: Database-driven personalisation with custom app name, logo, favicon, and colour scheme per tenant. Supports dark and light themes with persistent preference.
about.mod17Desc: Admin-customisable dropdown options for project types, engagement models, statuses, roles, regions, date formats, and more. Adapt the platform to your organisation's terminology.
about.mod18Desc: Operational and executive reports with server-side aggregation. Portfolio Health overview, single-project Status snapshots, Milestone Tracker with financial obligations, and RAID Summary across all projects. Export to CSV and PDF for offline distribution.
about.mod19Desc: Strategic outcome register for tracking value realisation across the portfolio. Link outcomes to companies, opportunities, projects, and governance stages. Measure baseline, target, and current values with evidence-based progress tracking.
about.cap1Desc: Organise work into phases and workstreams with automatic parent-child relationships, status cascading, and date validation.
about.cap2Desc: Opportunities use a price-driven model: Base Price (hours x bill rate), Risk-Adjusted Price, and Buffered Price with configurable risk and buffer percentages. Gross Margin calculated as (Buffered Price - Base Cost) / Buffered Price.
about.cap3Desc: Four independent, colour-coded health dimensions — Overall, Scope, Budget, and Team Composition — for rapid project assessment.
about.cap4Desc: Industry-standard EVM metrics computed from allocations (PV), timesheets (AC), and progress entries (EV) with historical snapshot tracking and revision versioning.
about.cap5Desc: Five-stage governance framework with pass/fail gate enforcement, AI evaluator assessment, exception workflows, and configurable stage definitions.
about.cap6Desc: Per-deliverable RACI (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed) matrices ensure clear role assignments across all governance stages.
about.cap7Desc: Automated gate readiness assessment that checks checkpoint completion, artifact presence and quality, RAID status, and EVM indicators to provide structured pass/fail recommendations.
about.cap8Desc: Connect Google Drive folders to projects. Link deliverable artifacts to governance checkpoints and run AI-powered verification to ensure documents meet requirements.
about.cap9Desc: One-click conversion from won opportunities to delivery projects. Copies phases, workstreams, milestones, resources, team composition, allocations, and RAID items. Duplicate-conversion guard prevents accidental re-conversion.
about.cap10Desc: Six pre-sales deliverables (Deal Context, Scope Definition Pack, Solution Approach, Delivery Feasibility Review, SOW, Sales-to-Delivery Handoff Pack) with RACI matrices.
about.cap11Desc: Download a pre-formatted Excel template to define phases, workstreams, and resources offline. Import the completed template to bulk-create the estimate hierarchy.
about.cap12Desc: Auto-populate team composition from workstream resources. Consolidates by rate card, calculates required FTEs using peak concurrent hours, and computes the delta against existing team entries.
about.cap13Desc: Configurable security roles with module-level permissions and record-level filtering. Admin-managed Role Builder, Role Matrix, user-role assignments, and audit logging for sensitive actions.
about.cap14Desc: Full tenant isolation across all data tables. Automated provisioning pipeline seeds RBAC roles, governance stages, settings, and branding for new tenants.
about.cap15Desc: New tenants are immediately functional after creation — RBAC system roles, permissions, governance stages, app settings, branding, and admin user assignment are all seeded automatically.
about.cap16Desc: Import project data from Excel (.xlsx, .xls) and CSV files for rapid project setup and migration from existing tools.
about.cap17Desc: Toggle between dark and light modes. Theme preference is persisted and applied consistently across all pages.
about.cap18Desc: Tenant-customisable governance framework with configurable labels, stages, deliverables, RACI roles, and gate criteria. AI Coach dynamically adapts to your framework.
about.cap19Desc: Generate secure Bearer tokens for external API access. Tokens are SHA-256 hashed, scoped to a single tenant, support configurable expiration (30 days, 90 days, 1 year, or never), and inherit the creating user's RBAC permissions. Create, list, and revoke tokens from the Settings page.
about.cap20Desc: Full multi-language support for English, Spanish, and Portuguese. Locale is set per tenant at creation and applies across the UI, picklist defaults, governance labels, and AI Coach responses. Translation covers 300+ keys across all modules.
about.cap21Desc: Chronological audit log of sensitive actions across the platform. Tracks user activity, role changes, permission updates, and security events with timestamps and actor identification for compliance and accountability.
about.cap22Desc: Executive-grade portfolio overview surfacing portfolio health distribution, margin exposure, at-risk projects, overdue milestones, critical RAID items, and gate exceptions in a single view for rapid decision-making.
